about: AhnLab, Inc. provides information security solutions and services for consumers, enterprises, and small and medium businesses worldwide. It offers AhnLab AI PLUS, an AI security platform; AhnLab V3, a set of anti-malware products that protect desktops, laptops and servers; AhnLab EPP which unifies modern endpoint security tools across anti-malware, security assessment, patch management, personal data protection, and endpoint detection and response; AhnLab MDS, a sandbox solution that provides advanced threat detection, analysis and response capabilities; AhnLab EDR that detects advanced threats through behavioral analysis, AI-driven investigation, and proactive threat hunting; AhnLab Office Security, a SaaS-based security management solution; and AhnLab V3 Mobile, a set of mobile security products. The company also provides network security solutions, including NGFW, IPS, DDoS mitigation, and sandboxing to deliver unified protection; AhnLab CPP, a cloud workload protection platform; AhnLab XTG VM, a cloud firewall that delivers power protection for business assets; AhnLab AIPS VM, a cloud-optimized intrusion prevention system; and AhnLab TMS VM, a unified cloud network security management. In addition, it offers AhnLab XDR for granular threat detection, precise risk identification, contextual analysis and optimal response; AhnLab TIP, a threat intelligence platform; AhnLab SOAR, which automates and modernizes security operations; and AhnLab SOAR Basic for automating security operations. Further, the company provides CPS protection platform which secures cyber-physical systems, including OT endpoints, networks, and OT-connected IT systems of various industry verticals, such as manufacturing, gas, energy, and transportation. Additionally, it offers MDR, MDD, professional, security consulting, digital forensics, cloud and managed services. AhnLab, Inc. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Seongnam-si, South Korea.
